fee_notes: Fee varies by number of Franchised Businesses purchased simultaneously: 1 unit = $49,500; 2 units = $42,500 each; 3 or more units = $34,500 each. Active-duty military, honorably discharged veterans, law enforcement, healthcare providers, and emergency service personnel receive a $5,000 discount on the first Franchised Business. All fees are due at signing, fully earned, and non-refundable. During fiscal year ended December 31, 2023, the standard fee of $49,500 was collected except for one franchise where the fee was waived for an existing franchisee who closed due to property damage in 2020 and reopened in 2023.
raw_excerpt:
You must pay us the following initial franchise fee ("Initial Franchise Fee") for each Franchised Business purchased at the same time:

Franchised Business Purchased | Initial Franchise Fee
1 | $49,500
2 | $42,500
3 or more | $34,500 each

All Initial Franchise Fees are uniform and due at the time of signing each Franchise Agreement. To qualify for the discounted Initial Franchise Fee on the second and subsequent Franchised Businesses, the Franchise Agreements and Initial Franchise Fees must be executed and paid at the same time. The Initial Franchise Fee will be paid by means of cashier's check, money order or wire transfer.
